news.title: UW–Madison project joins with MMSD to meet pressing student needs
news.summary_en: When the Madison Education Partnership (MEP) launched in 2016, its goal was simple but ambitious: bring together researchers and educators to address real problems facing Madison’s public schools to contribute to change locally and inform research nationally.
